subject.title: fix(swarm): live agents.run fan-outs launch collectors

question: Should every in-process `agent` dispatch use the gateway's synthetic host identity when a CLI or HTTP parent initiates the turn?
rationale: This decision defines the boundary between legitimate gateway-owned collector launches and external callers that must remain unable to spoof collector fields; source review cannot substitute for maintainer intent on that trust model.

options.title: Confirm the scoped host identity
options.body: Keep the current change after confirming that all direct in-process `agent` dispatches are host-owned paths and retain the external-client rejection regression coverage.

options.title: Narrow the trusted caller path
options.body: Use a more specific internal launch marker if any in-process `agent` caller is not intended to receive host collector authority.

recommendation.title: Confirm the scoped host identity
recommendation.body: Keep the current change after confirming that all direct in-process `agent` dispatches are host-owned paths and retain the external-client rejection regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identified author of the related Swarm design and the proposed boundary repair.
